A_rational_curves_surfaces.name: rational curves and surfaces in H_tr
A_rational_curves_surfaces.method: H_tr is a P^3 in P(E). Restrict the 11-torsor (Kummer class of psi_B(b c^{-1})) to low-degree rational curves/surfaces meeting the torus open. Seek a family where the class is an identical 11th power.

B_additive_hilbert_90.name: additive Hilbert 90
